steps.action: Open the project directory and select a stable project link.
steps.observe: The selected project identity and visibility boundary are announced.

steps.action: Resolve project membership and source freshness.
steps.observe: Workspace orientation shows authority, freshness, and a visible state label.

steps.action: Inspect the resulting project workspace or access explanation.
steps.observe: The reader sees project context or an explicit locked/unavailable/error reason, never a guessed empty fallback.

flows.outcome: workspace orientation or explicit reason access cannot proceed
flows.a11y: landmarks, h1, visible state text, non-color cue, focus on error/locked boundary
flows.failure: not found, locked, unavailable, stale, or error; never empty fallback

steps.action: Open the workspace attention region.
steps.observe: Each derived attention item shows a reason, source object, actor, and freshness.

steps.action: Choose the named source link.
steps.observe: The source work item opens through a stable deep link without a mutation control.

steps.action: Return to the workspace attention context.
steps.observe: Focus and the prior inspection context are restored; stale or unavailable remains distinct.

flows.outcome: deep link to work item without mutation
flows.a11y: reason is text, marker is non-color, link has object name, focus preserved on return
flows.failure: no attention is empty; stale/unavailable/error stays distinct

steps.action: Open a work item marked blocked.
steps.observe: Blocked status and its non-color barrier cue are visible as text.

steps.action: Expand the blocker explanation.
steps.observe: The causal dependency or decision includes authority and changed time.

steps.action: Follow the dependency or escalation reference.
steps.observe: The next useful inspection path is available; no automatic resolution is offered.

flows.translation: Work is blocked: [reason]. [Actor] recorded it at [time].
flows.outcome: inspect blocker or escalate; no automatic resolution
flows.a11y: barrier icon plus text, labelled dependency link, heading structure
flows.failure: missing cause is an error/data-quality state, not a guessed blocker

steps.action: Open the current execution region for a work item.
steps.observe: Run identity, executor, lifecycle, and start time are visible.

steps.action: Inspect the finished or active run details.
steps.observe: Finish time and result are separated from work-item lifecycle.

steps.action: Open the latest evidence category.
steps.observe: The reader is told to inspect evidence before treating the run as meaningful progress.

flows.translation: Execution run [state] by [actor] [time]. Inspect evidence before deciding.
flows.outcome: distinguish run result from work-item lifecycle
flows.a11y: progress has text and time, actor is announced, no spinner-only state
flows.failure: run unavailable/stale/error is explicit; completion never implies acceptance

steps.action: Open the validation and evidence summary.
steps.observe: Category, exact check, target, observed result, and redaction boundary are listed.

steps.action: Select an evidence pointer.
steps.observe: Minimized metadata is shown while loading, stale, unavailable, or blocked results remain explicit.

steps.action: Attempt the protected artifact read.
steps.observe: Authorized readers see the artifact; locked readers see no protected preview.

flows.outcome: view minimized metadata or authorized artifact
flows.a11y: category and result are text, artifact link name is descriptive, locked content has no preview
flows.failure: locked means no plaintext; unavailable is source failure; blocked check is not pass/fail

steps.action: Open the review section after evidence is available.
steps.observe: Review pending shows reviewer role, request time, and referenced run/evidence.

steps.action: Inspect the independent verdict record.
steps.observe: Accepted, rejected, or rework is displayed with reviewer, time, and feedback boundary.

steps.action: Follow findings when the verdict is rejected or rework.
steps.observe: The surface remains read-only and exposes no self-approval or mutation affordance.

flows.outcome: read-only display of verdict; decision is external to this item
flows.a11y: verdict is explicit text, reviewer role is visible, no self-approval or mutation control
flows.failure: missing independent reviewer is pending/error; rejected is not blocked

steps.action: Open optional iteration context from the workspace.
steps.observe: The project workspace remains primary and labels iteration as optional.

steps.action: Select an iteration when one exists.
steps.observe: Goal, selected work item IDs, and freshness appear as secondary context.

steps.action: Continue with no iteration or when its source is unavailable.
steps.observe: Project, attention, work, runs, evidence, and review remain usable without a board.

flows.translation: [Iteration] is optional context. This project remains useful without a sprint.
flows.outcome: filter context or continue project-first workspace
flows.a11y: optional context is labelled, no board-only navigation, no-sprint message is visible
flows.failure: absent iteration is not an error; unavailable iteration never removes project work

steps.action: Open the project timeline.
steps.observe: Events appear in ordered-list semantics with event ID/type, actor class, and timestamp.

steps.action: Select an event object reference.
steps.observe: The referenced project object opens when available; missing references remain inspectable as events.

steps.action: Inspect redacted or protected event detail.
steps.observe: Human translation and coarse visibility are shown without fabricating protected plaintext.

flows.outcome: trace provenance to object without treating narrative as plaintext authority
flows.a11y: ordered list semantics, event type/time in text, redaction explained, keyboard links
flows.failure: missing object remains an event; protected payload is redacted/locked, never fabricated
